expr: (() => { const b = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(x => /sign in|log in|submit/i.test(x.textContent || '')); if (b) { b.click(); return 'clicked login'; } return 'no login button'; })()

(() => { const b = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(x => (x.textContent || '').trim() === 'Channels'); if (!b) return 'no channels tab'; b.click(); return 'opened channels tab'; })()

(() => { const t = document.body.innerText; return 'channelsTab=' + (t.includes('Add webhook') && t.includes('Configured channels')) + ';generic=' + t.includes('generic-proof') + ';slack=' + t.includes('slack-proof') + ';formats=' + (t.includes('generic') && t.includes('slack')); })()

(() => { const rows = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('li')); const target = rows.find(r => (r.innerText||'').includes('generic-proof')); if (!target) return 'row not found'; const b = Array.from(target.querySelectorAll('button')).find(x => (x.textContent||'').includes('Test')); if (!b) return 'no test button'; b.click(); return 'clicked Test on generic-proof'; })()
(() => { const t = document.body.innerText; return 'toast=' + (t.includes('Test message delivered') ? 'yes' : 'no'); })()
